ngspice_init: * ngspice init settings for the sky130 PDK model libraries.
* The corner runner copies this file into its scratch run directory as
* `.spiceinit` before invoking ngspice, so runs do not depend on whatever
* happens to be in ~/.spiceinit. To drive ngspice by hand with the same
* settings, copy this file to `.spiceinit` in your working directory.
* Same settings as the sibling sky130-bandgap harness (same PDK, same pin):
* derived from the PDK's own libs.tech/ngspice/spinit, kept in-repo so the
* settings a record was produced under are versioned with the harness.
set ngbehavior=hsa     ; HSPICE-ish compatibility, required to read PDK libs
set skywaterpdk        ; skip some checks for faster lib loading
set ng_nomodcheck      ; do not check model parameters
option noinit          ; do not dump operating point data into the log
option klu             ; KLU direct linear solver
